title: PR #7: fix(ci): synchronize GlobusOS lockfile and ATCLang Ruff gate
content:
State: closed
Merged: True

Fixes the next concrete failures from Ecosystem Release Readiness run #12. The ATCLang REPL import block now carries the narrowly scoped Ruff I001 suppression required by the repository's actual Ruff configuration, and the GlobusOS package-lock is synchronized from TypeScript 7.0.2 to the declared TypeScript 6.0.3 dependency so npm ci can execute deterministically.
